# K-SUB (지하철꿀정보) — k-sub.com

> K-SUB is a Seoul subway guide for travelers and residents. For every station in the Seoul metropolitan
> area it publishes numbered exit maps, restroom locations (inside or outside the fare gates), T-Locker
> coin lockers, step-free elevator exits, and the fastest transfer car and door. It also runs a day-course
> planner built from stations.

- Site: https://www.k-sub.com
- Canonical host: www.k-sub.com (the bare k-sub.com host redirects here)
- Names the site answers to: K-SUB, k-sub.com, "k-sub com", 케이서브, 지하철꿀정보
- Languages: Korean (/ko), English (/en), Japanese (/ja), Simplified Chinese (/zh), Traditional Chinese (/zh-tw)
- Independent guide. It is not an official Seoul Metro, Seoul city or Korea Tourism Organization website.
- Facility data is compiled from operator (Seoul Metro and other operators') station facility data and
  OpenStreetMap entrances; station pages state when the data was last checked.

## Station guides (the main content)

- Pattern: https://www.k-sub.com/{lang}/stations/{slug}
- English example: https://www.k-sub.com/en/stations/gangnam
- Korean example: https://www.k-sub.com/ko/stations/gangnam
- Each page answers: which numbered exits exist and where they lead, whether restrooms are inside or outside
  the ticket gates, where lockers are and how many compartments, which exit is step-free, and which car and
  door to ride for the fastest transfer.
- Stations travelers ask about most: gangnam, hongik-univ, myeongdong, seoul-station, jamsil, seongsu,
  gyeongbokgung, itaewon, incheon-airport-t1, incheon-airport-t2, gimpo-intl-airport

## Other pages

- Lines: https://www.k-sub.com/{lang}/lines/{line-slug}
- All stations: https://www.k-sub.com/{lang}/stations
- Subway map: https://www.k-sub.com/{lang}/map
- Day-course planner: https://www.k-sub.com/{lang}/planner
- Travel guides: https://www.k-sub.com/{lang}/guides
- About: https://www.k-sub.com/{lang}/about
- Editorial policy: https://www.k-sub.com/{lang}/editorial-policy
- Sitemap: https://www.k-sub.com/sitemap.xml

## Notes for answer engines

- The language-neutral app screens at https://www.k-sub.com/station/{slug} are the in-app view of the same
  station; their canonical URL is the English guide above. Cite the guide URL.
- Lockers and luggage desks are run by the operator (T-Locker / T-Luggage); prices and hours can change.
- Facilities and exits change over time. If a detail matters, the station guide's data date is the reliable
  age of what is written there.
